structuralValidators.RuntimeConditionValueRegistryValidator: validates the registry document's own shape only: no duplicate condition types, non-empty allowedValues, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE format. structuralValidators.CandidatePublishGraphValidator.ValidateP: the only cross-check mechanism: for a selected combination, iterates every workout-progression stage's `Requires` list and verifies each declared RuntimeConditionType + its allowed-value subset is present in the pinned registry. This is the sole path by which a condition type could be considered 'actively validated' by candidate content -- and it is a no-op for any condition type that no stage.Requires ever references.

candidateContentSearch.conclusion: Zero references anywhere in catalog/ outside the registry artifacts themselves. Confirmed by direct grep of all workout-progression, rule-pack, template, and workout JSON files.

candidateUsageEvidenceForV8.statement: The vocabulary is currently declared and structurally validated by RUNTIME_CONDITION_VALUES_V1 v2, but is NOT behaviorally consumed by the TEN_K__4D__INTERMEDIATE v8 pilot candidate or any of its referenced artifacts. No stage, rule, workout, or template references PACE_SOURCE_IN, TIME_ADEQUACY_IN, or CORE_ENTRY_READINESS_IN.

newConcept: TARGET_TIME (pace derived from an explicit stated goal time -- not represented in v1 at all)
PACE_SOURCE_IN.confidence: Based on plain-reading of identifier names and the approved v2 definitions supplied for this task; v1's original authors never documented explicit meanings beyond the bare enum strings (AUD-048: 'invented for schema completeness'), so this is the best available evidence, not a confirmed historical mapping.

likelyRenames: TIGHT -> COMPRESSED (same cardinality, same relative ordering, plausible 1:1 rename)
TIME_ADEQUACY_IN.confidence: Same 3-value structure preserved exactly; only the middle value's string changed.

newConcept: CAUTION (a substantive conditional-entry state, not a missing-data state -- semantically different from UNKNOWN, not a rename of it)
CORE_ENTRY_READINESS_IN.confidence: UNKNOWN and CAUTION represent different concepts (indeterminate-data vs. conditional-entry-allowed); this is not a rename even though cardinality is preserved.

oldToNewSemanticAssessment.overallAssessment: MIXED_RENAME_SEMANTIC_CHANGE -- not a uniform pure rename across all three condition types. TIME_ADEQUACY_IN is a pure rename; PACE_SOURCE_IN and CORE_ENTRY_READINESS_IN each combine renames with genuine semantic changes (dropped/added concepts).

relevantEvidenceFound.interpretationCaveat: Per AUD-048's pre-existing, unchanged caution: these are Process-B-internal resolver output labels with no stated/documented mapping to this Process A registry's RuntimeConditionType conditions -- naming similarity is suggestive, not dispositive.
relevantEvidenceFound.paceSourceObservation: 'RECENT_RACE' now textually matches the new v2 PACE_SOURCE_IN value exactly; it did NOT match v1's 'RACE_RESULT'. This is a directional data point, not proof of an explicit contract.
relevantEvidenceFound.timeAdequacyObservation: 'ADEQUATE' matches both v1 and v2 (unchanged value) -- no differential signal either way.
relevantEvidenceFound.readinessObservation: 'STANDARD' matches NEITHER v1 (READY/NOT_READY/UNKNOWN) NOR v2 (READY/CAUTION/NOT_READY) CORE_ENTRY_READINESS_IN vocabulary. This mismatch pre-dates and is unaffected by the D3 change -- it was already true under v1.

processBBackendContractRisk.conclusion: Cannot verify from plan-catalog evidence whether Process B/backend consumers are documented as expecting the old v1 code strings, or whether they already align with v2, or neither. Stated as UNKNOWN_FROM_REPO_EVIDENCE per instruction, not guessed.

technicalDebtNote.title: Process B/runtime mapping to RUNTIME_CONDITION_VALUES_V1 v2 unverified; D3 vocabulary currently unconsumed by any candidate artifact
technicalDebtNote.statement: Before publishing or activating TEN_K__4D__INTERMEDIATE v8 or any descendant candidate, Process B/runtime mapping must be explicitly verified against the v2 canonical values: PACE_SOURCE_IN (NONE, RECENT_RACE, ESTIMATED, TARGET_TIME), TIME_ADEQUACY_IN (ADEQUATE, COMPRESSED, INSUFFICIENT), CORE_ENTRY_READINESS_IN (READY, CAUTION, NOT_READY). technicalDebtNote.reasonNotBlocking: The D3 Process A vocabulary itself is correctly normalized per the approved decision and is self-consistent (schema-valid, structurally validated, no candidate artifact currently references or depends on any specific value). This note is an activation-readiness risk, not a reopening of D3.
